thanks for helping with this. 🙏

Unfortunately I can't see the logs for these proposals, because the last one was 9 days ago, and we've since re-created the containers.

We're on a break now at Blox, and hopefully by the time we're back we'd have at least one 0-attestation proposal to share.

I agree that it's most likely due to hardware/network conditions.

The Lighthouse graffiti is dominant in all proposals, so that may explain the graffiti distribution above 😄
